findings.message: The password reset token lifetime grows from 1 hour to 24 hours in a PR about welcome email text. This widens the window in which a leaked or intercepted reset link can be used to take over an account, and nothing in the request explains it.
The new `welcome_message` function has no test, but the contributing guide requires a test with every change in behaviour.

criteria.note: Returns the subject "Welcome" and a body that greets `user.name`. No test covers it.

scope_creep.message: Changing the password reset token lifetime is not part of the welcome email requirement.
